title: Exclusive: Physical AI Startup Tractian Becomes a Unicorn
text: Tractian, a 7-year-old physical AI startup based in Atlanta, Georgia, has raised $130 million at a valuation of $1.4 billion in a Series D funding round led by Sapphire Ventures.
